name: xiaobei-growth
description: Operate social media accounts across Xiaohongshu, WeChat official accounts, Douyin, Kuaishou, TikTok, X and Weibo for customer acquisition, with content workflows, asset editing, platform APIs and performance reviews.

displayDescription.zh: 帮助OPC与中小企业运营小红书、公众号等账号，通过定位、内容创作发布、潜客互动与数据复盘实现获客。
displayDescription.en: Operate social media accounts across Xiaohongshu, WeChat official accounts and other supported platforms to attract customers through positioning, content creation, publishing, outreach and performance reviews.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是做【产品/服务】的，帮我在小红书找10个同赛道账号，逐个提取账号DNA，告诉我该学谁、怎么学。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My product or service is [describe it]. Find 10 Xiaohongshu accounts in the same niche, extract each account’s content DNA, and tell me whose approach to learn and how.

quickPrompts.zh: 我是做【产品/服务】的，帮我在小红书找10个同赛道账号，逐个提取账号DNA，告诉我该学谁、怎么学。
quickPrompts.en: My product or service is [describe it]. Find 10 Xiaohongshu accounts in the same niche, extract each account’s content DNA, and tell me whose approach to learn and how.

quickPrompts.zh: 给我的【产品/服务】做一组“问答讨论流”小红书卡片，配好标题、正文和话题，我确认后直接发布。
quickPrompts.en: Create a Q&A discussion card set for my [product/service] on Xiaohongshu, prepare its title, body and topics, and publish it after I approve.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的微信公众号是【公众号名/文章链接】，帮我找出定位、内容和获客的问题，给我最该先改的3件事。
quickPrompts.en: My WeChat official account is [account name/article links]. Diagnose its positioning, content and customer acquisition, and give me the 3 most important fixes.
